project.name: Enterprise Coding agent
project.objective: Build the minimum working, provider-agnostic Engineering Agent described in the attached System Design Document and Iteration 1 Technical Implementation Plan

plan_approval.reason: Iteration 2 task boundaries and proof gates reviewed

approval.reason: Iteration 2 context management requirements reviewed and approved

invariants.text: All file operations (read, search, edit, write) and command execution paths must strictly validate that targets reside within the configured workspace directory. Paths outside the workspace must be rejected.

The agent must never declare a coding task successful solely because the LLM produced a confident text response. Completion requires explicit verification (e.g., running tests/builds) or clear reporting of unverified status.
The agent loop must enforce a hard iteration cap (default 20) and detect repeated identical failing actions to prevent runaway execution or infinite thrashing loops.
invariants.source: Engineering Agent — Iteration 1 Technical Implementation Plan §16, §17

decisions.title: Provider-Agnostic LLM Abstraction
decisions.text: The Agent Loop must communicate with LLMs strictly through an internal provider-independent LLM interface. Direct SDK imports (e.g., Gemini) are confined entirely to their respective adapter modules.
decisions.source: Engineering Agent — Iteration 1 Technical Implementation Plan §4

decisions.title: Zero External Agent Frameworks
decisions.text: Do not introduce LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or other agent frameworks. The agent runtime, loop, state, tools, context, and provider adapters must be built directly using TypeScript/Node.js to ensure deep mechanical understanding.
decisions.source: Engineering Agent — Iteration 1 Technical Implementation Plan §3

decisions.title: Default Gemini Model: gemini-2.5-flash
decisions.text: The default Gemini model for Iteration 1 is gemini-2.5-flash via the @google/genai SDK. Configured via GEMINI_MODEL environment variable.

decisions.title: Edit Tool: Both replace and write operations
decisions.text: The file editing tool (src/tools/edit-file.ts) supports two operations in a single tool: (a) replace — exact deterministic substring replacement with single-match validation, and (b) write — create or overwrite entire file content.

decisions.title: Search Tool: Pure Node.js recursive directory walker
decisions.text: The search tool (src/tools/search.ts) implements a pure TypeScript/Node.js recursive directory traversal with regex/substring matching. No external binaries (ripgrep, grep, findstr) are required. This ensures 100% cross-platform compatibility on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

decisions.title: Command Safety: Deny-by-default for non-allowlisted commands
decisions.text: In non-interactive runs, any command not in the explicit allowlist (npm test, npm run test, npm run build, npm run lint, node ...) is immediately denied with a structured error message returned to the agent loop. No interactive confirmation prompts.

decisions.title: Project files at repo root, not subdirectory
decisions.text: All TypeScript project files (package.json, tsconfig.json, src/, tests/, eval/) live at the Genesis repo root. This is required because genesis gate runs commands from the repo root directory. A separate engineering-agent/ subdirectory would cause all gate commands to fail.

decisions.title: Iteration 2: Context Manager as Single Loop Entry Point
decisions.text: The Agent Loop (loop.ts) must delegate all context preparation to ContextManager. The loop must not contain context-selection, truncation, or compaction logic. ContextManager.buildManaged(state) replaces the existing assemble() call.

decisions.title: Iteration 2: Deterministic-Only Compaction (No LLM Summarization)
decisions.text: The first compaction implementation must use deterministic structured extraction: user task, modified files, commands, test results, important facts, errors. LLM-based summarization is explicitly deferred to a later iteration to ensure predictable, testable compaction behavior.

decisions.title: Iteration 2: src/context/context.ts Backward-Compatible Refactor
decisions.text: The existing ContextManager class in src/context/context.ts must be preserved as a shim or refactored in-place to delegate to the new subsystem. It must not be deleted; existing tests/unit/context.test.ts must continue to pass without modification.

knowledge.title: Iteration 1 Boundary & Non-Goals
knowledge.text: Iteration 1 MVP is strictly limited to CLI, Agent Runtime, Agent Loop, Gemini Adapter, 4 Core Tools (Read, Search, Edit/Write, Run Command), basic context with limits, structured event logging, unit tests, integration test fixture, and 5 evaluation tasks. Excludes RAG, vector DBs, sub-agents, memory, git automation, and web UI.
knowledge.source: Engineering Agent — Iteration 1 Technical Implementation Plan §31

knowledge.title: Iteration 2 Boundary and Non-Goals
knowledge.text: Iteration 2 adds context management only. Not in scope: RAG, embeddings, vector databases, persistent memory, sub-agents, model routing, MCP, automatic model switching, repository indexing, multi-agent communication. LLM-based compaction summarization deferred. Iteration 3 will address repository navigation and information discovery.

src/context/policies.ts implements ContextPolicy config loaded from env vars (MODEL_CONTEXT_TOKENS=32000, MODEL_OUTPUT_TOKENS=4096, CONTEXT_COMPACTION_THRESHOLD=0.80, per-tool caps), deterministic 7-step selection algorithm, content-hash duplicate detection, priority+recency sort. src/context/context-builder.ts implements ContextBuilder.build(input) returning BuildContextResult with LLM-ready messages ordered system->task->facts->recent-tools->recent-interaction->older->summaries, estimatedTokens, utilization, truncated, compacted, metrics.
